platforms.name: beehiiv
platforms.free_note: Free up to 2,500 subscribers, unlimited sends. No Ad Network or paid subscriptions on Free.
platforms.extras: Lite includes the beehiiv Ad Network, paid subscriptions (1 tier) and paid recommendations. Pro ($109/mo at 1k, $199/mo at 5k, monthly billing) adds the sponsorship storefront.

platforms.name: Kit
platforms.fee_text: 3.5% + $0.30 per sale, card processing included (page says Kit keeps 0.6%)
platforms.extras: Pro is $79/mo at 1k and $139/mo at 5k (monthly billing). Whether paid newsletters are enabled on the Free plan was not verified, so the cheapest charging plan is shown as Creator.

platforms.name: Substack
platforms.free_note: Free to publish, no subscriber cap. Substack only earns when you charge.

platforms.name: Ghost(Pro)
platforms.free_note: No free plan found on the pricing page (free trial only).
platforms.extras: Starter covers up to 1,000 members; above that you need Publisher (2,500 members $55/mo, 5,000 members $75/mo, monthly billing). Paid subscriptions are listed under Publisher.

platforms.name: MailerLite
platforms.extras: Power is $39/mo at 1k and $69/mo at 5k (monthly billing). Help page: Comfort or Power accounts can sell paid newsletters with Stripe.

platforms.name: Buttondown
platforms.extras: Slider has no exact 5,000 step: $29/mo at 4,800 subscribers, $79/mo at 5,100. The 5k price shown is the 4,800 tier. Yearly is $90 at 1,000 and $290 at the $29 tier (two months free); per-month figures are those divided by 12. Paid subscriptions are on the Basic plan.

platforms.name: Mailchimp
platforms.fee_text: not published (no paid-newsletter feature found on the pricing page)
platforms.extras: Standard is $45/mo at 501–1,500 contacts and $100/mo at 2,501–5,000 contacts. Yearly prices were not captured.

platforms.name: Flodesk
platforms.free_note: Free plan has no email sending (forms and landing pages only).
platforms.fee_text: No Flodesk fee listed on the checkout help page; Stripe 3% + $0.30 (US)
platforms.extras: Pro is $28/mo at 1k, $59/mo at 5k (monthly). Everything is $54/mo at 1k and $107/mo at 5k (monthly). 1k monthly prices confirmed by screenshot; 5k and annual figures are read from the page's rendered price list. Flodesk Checkout sells products and subscriptions; it is not a gated-newsletter product in the way Substack is.

platforms.name: AWeber
platforms.free_note: No permanent free plan shown on the pricing page (14-day trial).
platforms.extras: Plus is $30/mo (monthly) for up to 500 subscribers.

platforms.name: GetResponse
platforms.free_note: 14-day free trial; no permanent free plan found.
platforms.fee_text: No GetResponse fee on premium newsletters; Stripe fees apply
platforms.extras: Starter is $29/mo at 2,500 and $79/mo at 10,000 (monthly). Marketer is $59/mo at 1k and $95/mo at 5k (monthly). The help page does not name the plan needed for premium newsletters; search results pointed at Creator, so treat that plan as unconfirmed.
